card.name: Numbers in grades and dosing intervals
card.fires_on: Small numbers (3, 4, 8, eight) right after 'Grade' or 'every' in adverse-reaction rates and dosing-interval text. Also a digit inside a tablet strength such as 40 mg.

modes.label: Grade number
modes.description: The digit after 'Grade' in lists of adverse reaction severity percentages.

modes.label: Hours interval
modes.description: The number after 'every' before 'hours' in dosing schedules.
modes.example: Administer 10 mL (60 mg) every <<4>> hours with supplied prefilled oral syringe

card.writes: It seems to promote small count words such as 'few' and Chinese words for 'two kinds' or 'three kinds', so it favors small-number terms.
card.plain: It lights up on a small number that follows 'Grade' or 'every', as in severity grades and hourly dosing intervals.
